get.summary: Get information for multiple obligations that match the query.

parameters.name: DomainType
parameters.description: Obligations with one or more of the domain types specified.

parameters.name: TaxType
parameters.description: Obligations with one or more of the tax types specified.

parameters.name: DeliverableType
parameters.description: Obligations with one or more of the deliverable types specified.

parameters.name: ObligationType
parameters.description: Obligations with one or more of the obligation types specified.

parameters.name: Jurisdiction
parameters.description: Obligations with the Jurisidiction ID provided. Example - http://ontology.onesourcetax.com/core/jurisdiction:USA

parameters.name: TaxedAs
parameters.description: Obligations with one or more of the taxed as values specified.

parameters.name: UsReturnType
parameters.description: Obligations with one or more of the US return type values specified.

parameters.name: Form
parameters.description: Obligations with one or more of the forms specified.

parameters.name: TaxYearStartDate
parameters.description: Obligations valid for tax years starting on or after this date. UTC format should be used.

parameters.name: TaxYearEndDate
parameters.description: Obligations valid for tax years ending on or before this date. UTC format should be used.

parameters.name: ModifiedGte
parameters.description: Obligations that were last modified on or after the date specified. UTC format should be used.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: Offset based pagination - zero-based index specifying the first item in the collection to return. It cannot be a negative value. Default value of 0.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: Offset based pagination - maximum number of records to appear in the result. Default value of 10. Maximum value of 100.

post.summary: Provide due dates for an obligation based on calculation parameters.

OriginalDueDate.description: The original due date for the due date sequence

Extensions.description: All available extensions for the due date sequence

domainType.description: The domain types associated with the obligation.

taxType.description: The tax types associated with the obligation.

deliverableType.description: The deliverable types associated with the obligation.

obligationType.description: The obligation types associated with the obligation.

taxedAs.description: Taxed as values associated with the obligation.

usReturnType.description: US return types associated to this obligation.

dynamicAttributes.description: Dynamic attributes applicable to the obligation.

created.description: When this obligation was created, in UTC format.

modified.description: When this obligation was last updated, in UTC format.

classicCalendarTemplate.description: The template of the matching obligation in Calendar Classic.

Bearer.description: Enter the authorization token here. Example: Bearer ABC
